**Purpose:** Documentation and source-data validation for Figure 6 panels.

**Inputs:**
- `figure6/source_data/Figure 6-source data.xlsx` — GEM tracking and diffusion data
  - Sheet `Figure 6B`: mean squared displacement (MSD) vs lag time
  - Sheet `Figure 6C`: per-particle Deff(100 ms) and GEM fluorescence intensity
  - Sheet `Figure 6D`: per-particle Deff(100 ms) by condition and timepoint
  - Sheet `Figure S6A`: per-cell cell volume (used in S Fig 6)
  - Sheet `Figure S6B`: per-cell mitochondrial/cell volume % (used in S Fig 6)
- `Macro Script for imageJ/` — Fiji macro scripts used for image preprocessing and particle tracking

**Run from repo root:** `rmarkdown::render("figure6/Figure6.Rmd")`

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.retina = 2)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

data_dir <- "figure6/source_data"
src_file <- file.path(data_dir, "Figure 6-source data.xlsx")
```

---

## Panel A — Representative fluorescence images of GEMs

Panel A contains representative fluorescence microscopy images of genetically encoded
multimeric nanoparticles (GEMs) in WT vs rim15\u0394 cells. Images are not R-generated.

Raw images are available on Mendeley Data (https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/xdrdyd9mk8/1 and https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/r45w82vcbk/1).

---

## Panels B, C, D — GEM diffusion analysis

GEM particle tracking and diffusion analysis were performed using the following tools:

- **Image preprocessing and particle tracking** — Fiji macro scripts in
  `Macro Script for imageJ/` (including `Mosaic Tracking - updated.ijm`).
- **Particle tracking and Deff calculation** —
  [GemSpa (napari-gemspa)](https://github.com/liamholtlab/napari-gemspa).

The figure was assembled in Fiji. Per-particle measurements are in
`figure6/source_data/Figure 6-source data.xlsx`.

**Panel B:** Mean squared displacement (MSD) vs lag time \u03c4 for WT vs rim15\u0394
across three conditions (proliferating, carbon starvation, phosphorus starvation).

**Panel C:** Per-particle Deff(100 ms) vs GEM fluorescence intensity — illustrates
the monomer-gating strategy used to exclude aggregated particles.

**Panel D:** Per-particle Deff(100 ms) over the time course for WT vs rim15\u0394
in carbon and phosphorus starvation.

```{r panels-BCD-source-data}
# Panel B — MSD vs lag time
raw_B <- read_excel(src_file, sheet = "Figure 6B", col_names = FALSE)
msd <- raw_B[3:nrow(raw_B), ] %>%
  setNames(as.character(raw_B[2, ])) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
stopifnot(nrow(msd) > 0, "t (sec)" %in% colnames(msd))
message("Figure 6B: ", nrow(msd), " lag-time points, ",
        ncol(msd) - 1, " conditions")

# Panel C — per-particle Deff-100ms and GEM intensity
raw_C <- read_excel(src_file, sheet = "Figure 6C", col_names = FALSE)
# 6 conditions × 2 columns (Deff-100ms, intensity), every 3rd column is blank
cond_names <- as.character(raw_C[1, ])
var_names   <- as.character(raw_C[2, ])
gem_scatter <- map_dfr(seq(1, 16, by = 3), function(col_i) {
  cond <- cond_names[col_i]
  vals_deff <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(raw_C[[col_i    ]][3:nrow(raw_C)]))
  vals_int  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(raw_C[[col_i + 1]][3:nrow(raw_C)]))
  tibble(condition = cond,
         deff_100ms = vals_deff[!is.na(vals_deff) & !is.na(vals_int)],
         intensity  = vals_int[ !is.na(vals_deff) & !is.na(vals_int)])
})
stopifnot(nrow(gem_scatter) > 0)
message("Figure 6C: ", nrow(gem_scatter), " per-particle measurements across ",
        n_distinct(gem_scatter$condition), " conditions")

# Panel D — Deff-100ms by condition and timepoint
raw_D <- read_excel(src_file, sheet = "Figure 6D", col_names = FALSE)
# Row 1: starvation type (Carbon / Phosphorus); row 2: genotype-timepoint; rows 3+: values
starv_type <- as.character(raw_D[1, ])
for (i in seq_along(starv_type))
  if (is.na(starv_type[i]) && i > 1) starv_type[i] <- starv_type[i - 1]
col_labels <- as.character(raw_D[2, ])
gem_deff <- map_dfr(seq_len(ncol(raw_D)), function(col_i) {
  if (is.na(col_labels[col_i])) return(tibble())
  vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(raw_D[[col_i]][3:nrow(raw_D)]))
  vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
  tibble(starvation = starv_type[col_i],
         label      = col_labels[col_i],
         deff_100ms = vals)
}) %>%
  mutate(
    genotype = if_else(startsWith(label, "WT"), "WT", "rim15\u0394"),
    timepoint = sub("^(WT|rim15\u0394)-", "", label)
  )
stopifnot(nrow(gem_deff) > 0)
message("Figure 6D: ", nrow(gem_deff), " per-particle measurements")
gem_deff %>% count(starvation, genotype, timepoint)
```
